title: Broccoli Cheddar Egg Muffins
description: Portable baked egg cups with broccoli and cheddar.
substitutions: Use cooked spinach or peppers instead of broccoli.

steps.text: Heat oven to 350°F and grease 6 muffin cups.
Whisk eggs, milk, salt, and pepper. Stir in broccoli and cheese.
Divide among cups and bake 18–20 minutes until puffed and set.

cookSteps.text: Heat oven to 350°F and grease 6 muffin cups.
Whisk 6 eggs with 1/4 cup milk, 1/4 teaspoon salt, and 1/4 teaspoon black pepper. Stir in 1 cup cooked broccoli and 3/4 cup cheddar.
Divide among the cups and bake 18–20 minutes until puffed and set.

storage: Refrigerate up to 4 days. Reheat 20–30 seconds in the microwave.

title: Brown Sugar Cinnamon Toast
description: Crisp buttery toast with a caramelized cinnamon-brown-sugar top.
substitutions: Use stale bread; it crisps especially well.

steps.text: Mix butter, brown sugar, and cinnamon. Spread over bread.
Broil or toast 2–4 minutes until bubbling and crisp at the edges. Watch closely.

cookSteps.text: Heat the broiler or toaster oven.
Mix 2 tablespoons softened butter with 2 tablespoons brown sugar and 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon. Spread over 4 slices bread.
Broil or toast 2–4 minutes until bubbling and crisp at the edges. Stay nearby so the sugar does not burn.

title: One-Pot Spinach Lemon Rice
description: Fluffy lemony rice with spinach folded in at the end.
substitutions: Use frozen spinach, thawed and squeezed dry.
Use bottled lemon juice plus a pinch of dried herbs.

steps.text: Combine rice, broth or water, butter or oil, and salt in a saucepan. Bring to a boil.
Cover, reduce heat to low, and cook 18 minutes.
Remove from heat, stir in spinach, lemon zest, and lemon juice, cover, and rest 5 minutes.

cookSteps.text: Combine 1 cup rice, 2 cups broth or water, 1 tablespoon butter or oil, and 1/2 teaspoon salt in a saucepan. Bring to a boil.
Cover, reduce heat to low, and cook 18 minutes.
Remove from heat. Stir in 3 cups spinach plus the zest and juice of 1 lemon. Cover and rest 5 minutes.

title: Small-Batch Chocolate Peanut Butter Oat Bars
description: Soft chewy oat bars with peanut butter and a little chocolate.
equipment: 8-inch loaf pan or small baking dish
substitutions: Use another nut or seed butter.
Use raisins instead of chocolate chips.

steps.text: Heat oven to 350°F and line or grease a small baking dish.
Stir together oats, peanut butter, brown sugar, egg, and milk. Fold in chocolate chips if using.
Press into the dish and bake 16–18 minutes until set around the edges. Cool before slicing.

cookSteps.text: Heat oven to 350°F and line or grease a small baking dish.
Stir together 1 cup oats, 1/2 cup peanut butter, 1/4 cup brown sugar, 1 egg, and 1/4 cup milk. Fold in 1/4 cup chocolate chips if using.
Press into the dish and bake 16–18 minutes until set around the edges.
Cool before slicing so the bars hold together.

storage: Store covered at room temperature 2 days or refrigerate up to 5 days.
